caseNameFull: Palmer Brothers Company v. D. E. Weaver, Chief of Bureau of Inspection, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Edwin W. Smith, with whom Mr. Frank L. McGuire was on the brief, for appellant. Mr. E. Lowry Humes, with whom Mr. George W. Wood-ruff and Mr. Jas. 0. Campbell were on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Decree affirmed with costs, upon the authority of Chicago Great Western Ry. Co. v. Kendall, ante, 94, and last paragraph of opinion therein.
